system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
**Review basis:** The Seller’s “STANDARD”, “FINAL”, market-practice and principal-agreement assertions are not buyer approvals. No Amelia Frost approval has been provided for any fallback. The underlying DD documents and current facts must be checked; the Seller’s summaries are not independent verification.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | 20% / **AUD 4.8m** for general Warranty Claims. | **25% / AUD 6m**; 20% only with Amelia’s prior written authority identifying the draft. | **Reject; restore 25%.** Matching a conditional fallback does not establish authority to accept it. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 de minimis; AUD 250,000 deductible basket, recovering only the excess. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis; **AUD 50,000 tipping basket**, recovering from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Amend both thresholds and recovery mechanics.** The Seller’s structure excludes materially more otherwise recoverable loss. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | 18 months; limitations presumptively apply to all Claims. | **24 months after Completion** for general warranties; 18 months only with Amelia’s written approval. | **Restore 24 months and remove the cross-category default.** Neither the shorter period nor its extension to other categories is authorised. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title subject to general caps and time limits. | Separate regime: **100% cap**, **at least six years**, outside general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject general-regime treatment.** Ownership and capacity risks require distinct protection. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedies and non-reliance apply to all Claims without an express exception. | Fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct excluded from **all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance**, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insert an overriding carve-out throughout.** This protection is mandatory and cannot be waived. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | Whole-data-room, accounts, statutory-register and public-record general disclosure. | **Specific fair disclosure** sufficient to identify the nature and scope of the relevant matter; no deemed disclosure through searches or bulk materials. | **Reject blanket disclosure and require properly particularised disclosures.** Document availability alone must not defeat warranty protection. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | No claim for buyer/adviser knowledge, including matters discoverable from the data room or public records. | Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions; any knowledge qualification must use named Seller knowledge persons and reasonable enquiry, never excusing title, capacity, fraud or specific indemnities. | **Delete clause 8.3’s exclusion.** Constructive knowledge would improperly transfer undisclosed-risk responsibility to the Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition satisfied on delivery of written consent, although no final consent or conditions evidence is supplied. | **Effective consent and evidence that all associated conditions are satisfied before Completion.** | **Strengthen the Completion condition and obtain current evidence.** Delivery alone does not establish effective consent for a customer representing approximately 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; security release after Completion; no repayment or final discharge supplied. | Current payout statement, direct repayment from Completion funds and effective security releases; deferred release only with an irrevocable undertaking **and Amelia’s approval**. | **Reject the unsupported post-Completion release arrangement.** The Buyer must not complete with uncontrolled financing or security exposure. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional bonuses omitted from funds flow and described as the Seller’s matter; on-costs unspecified. | Explicit funds-flow line for **AUD 420,000 plus triggered on-costs**, or demonstrably Seller-funded payment. | **Reconcile entitlement conditions and on-costs, then expressly allocate and fund payment.** Calling bonuses the Seller’s responsibility does not prevent the Company bearing an unfunded liability. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity confined to the SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 recorded open, without independent payment verification or confirmatory assignment. | Broader protection for resulting ownership, transfer and related IP exposure, preserving the **SOW3 cure** and verifying payment and transfer requirements. | **Broaden the indemnity and obtain cure evidence.** AUD 180,000 is not independently verified as paid or unpaid, and a payment-only indemnity may miss consequential IP exposure. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter said not to be material; access, scope and notification requirements remain unresolved. | Preserve logs, investigate access and scope, require updates and assess applicable response obligations on evidence. | **Keep open and require preservation, investigation and reporting obligations.** Neither a confirmed breach, harm, notification duty nor any numeric demand is established. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | AUD 330,000 aggregate characterised as ordinary-course operating costs, without supporting conclusions on timing or obligations. | Assess DD-008 and DD-011 together for scope, timing, accrual, avoidability, termination rights and ordinary-course status. | **Reserve classification pending verification; no automatic Debt treatment or price deduction.** Neither the Seller’s characterisation nor a purchase-price adjustment is established. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | General limitations presumptively govern all Claims, including tax and IP. | Separate **Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant** categories with express applicable regimes and no hidden general override. | **Remove catch-all language and check definitions and cross-references.** Specific protections must not be silently neutralised by general limitations. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | DD-012 internal share register offered as evidence of 100% ownership. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrance status and Seller authority, reconciled with the register. | **Obtain independent verification before Completion.** DD-012 identifies the supplied source; it is not independent proof of clean, transferable title. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Tax and IP positions described as settled under the general regime. | Keep both **OPEN**, with category-specific scope, limitations and remedies negotiated separately. | **Reject the asserted settlement and reserve both categories.** No resolution or unlimited liability may be assumed. |
=== END ADVICE ===
